risk_factors.heading: The rating of our debt by major rating agencies may further improve or deteriorate, which could affect our additional borrowing capacity and financing costs.
risk_factors.quote: Actual or anticipated changes or downgrades in our credit ratings, including any announcement that our ratings are under further review for a downgrade, could affect our market value and/or increase our corporate borrowing costs.

risk_factors.heading: The price of our common stock historically has been volatile. The price of our common stock may fluctuate significantly.
risk_factors.quote: The market price of our common stock is likely to continue to be volatile and subject to significant price and volume fluctuations for many reasons

risk_factors.heading: We may have fluctuations in the amount and frequency of our stock repurchases.
risk_factors.quote: The amount, timing, and execution of our stock repurchases may fluctuate based on our priorities for the use of cash for other purposes

risk_factors.heading: There can be no assurance that we will continue to declare cash dividends.
risk_factors.quote: The declaration and payment of any dividend is subject to the approval of our board, and our dividend may be discontinued or reduced at any time.

risk_factors.heading: The impact of a negative performance of financial markets and demographic trends on our defined benefit pension liabilities and costs cannot be predicted.
risk_factors.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had recognized a net accrued benefit liability of $342 million, representing the unfunded benefit obligations of our defined pension plans.

risk_factors.heading: Future changes to Dutch, U.S. and other foreign tax laws could adversely affect us.
risk_factors.quote: the EU has adopted a directive on ensuring a global minimum level of taxation for multinational companies, also known as Pillar 2, which became effective in 2024.

risk_factors.heading: We are exposed to a number of different tax uncertainties, which could have an impact on our results.
risk_factors.quote: Transfer pricing uncertainties can also result from disputes with local tax authorities about transfer pricing of internal deliveries of goods and services or related to financing, acquisitions and divestments
